detailed_description: The Cookie Policy Generator is a specialized tool that automates the creation of legally compliant cookie policies for websites. Technically, it parses regulatory requirements from frameworks like GDPR, CCPA, and ePrivacy into structured policy language by analyzing user-defined parameters such as cookie categories (e.g., strictly necessary, performance, analytics), data retention periods, and third-party integrations. It employs a rules engine to cross-reference selected options against jurisdiction-specific mandates, dynamically generating clauses about consent mechanisms, opt-out processes, and data processor disclosures. This tool addresses critical use cases: developers needing to implement IAB Transparency & Consent Framework v2.0 compliance, e-commerce platforms handling cross-border transactions, or startups avoiding legal penalties during audits. The backend uses a templating system with merge tags for variables like domain names and cookie durations, while the frontend provides a decision-tree interface to simplify complex legal logic into user-friendly selections.
usage_steps: Select cookie categories from a checklist (Strictly Necessary, Targeting, Preference, Performance)
Input domain-specific details via text fields (e.g., website URL, business name, Data Protection Officer contact)
Choose jurisdiction checkboxes (GDPR, CCPA, Brazil LGPD) to auto-populate required disclosures
Configure consent banner behavior using toggle switches for features like granular opt-in/out and cookie lifespan controls
Customize third-party integrations by selecting from a dropdown list (Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, Hotjar)
Generate and download the policy document in HTML or plain text format with embedded compliance timestamps
usage_examples: A SaaS startup generates a policy with opt-out links for EU users while enabling CCPA-compliant deletion requests for California customers
A food blog owner selects 'Performance Cookies' to automatically include MaxMind geolocation compliance clauses
An enterprise DevOps team integrates the API endpoint into their CI/CD pipeline to auto-update policies when new tracking scripts are deployed
A digital marketing agency creates customized policies for multiple clients with varying third-party ad tech stacks using bulk generation mode
